title: done refuses a story or bug with touches whose work was committed under its tasks
goal: backlog.py done's KB-Work rule counts commits naming the item or any of its descendants, so a story or bug with touches whose tasks carried the work is done without an extra commit; a test in test_backlog.py closes such a story, and a planted story with no commit under it or its tasks is still refused

run: import pathlib; t=pathlib.Path('_tools/backlog.py').read_text(encoding='utf-8'); assert 'not item_commits(bl.root, [iid] + bl.descendants(iid))' in t
